# FindText for AutoHotkey v2

Author: FeiYue. Version 9.9 (2024-09-16).
Original discussion: https://www.autohotkey.com/boards/viewtopic.php?f=83&t=116471
Source mirror: https://github.com/SalmonDXH/macro-library/blob/main/ahk/FindText.ahk
Retrieved 2026-11-02. Original attribution is preserved in FindText.ahk.

Local adaptation: removed the standalone capture GUI entry so bundling the library cannot open it at app startup. Runtime detection uses fixed binary icon patterns from robbery-patterns.ahk; the capture/editor UI is never invoked.
